# Entities reference

Every class in `assets/scripts/entities/`, from its doc comments. The overview is in [README.md](README.md).

- [EntityNumber](#entitynumber)

## EntityNumber

`res://assets/scripts/entities/EntityNumber.gd`, extends [`RefCounted`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_refcounted.html)

One number for every entity, the same on every machine and in every replay (pawn spec 16.9).

An entity's number is its network entity id when it has one, or else a hash of its path in the scene tree (a level's own pawns, offline). Everything that needs to name an entity across machines uses it: AI rolls and stagger, hit lists and hit order, effect sources, ties. Instance ids differ between machines and runs, so they're only for bookkeeping that stays on one machine. A pawn keeps its own (`Pawn.entity_number()`); this class works it out for anything else. A static class: nothing to add to a scene.

### Constants

- `NONE = -1`: No entity (null, or freed).

### Functions

- `of(entity: Variant) -> int` *(static)*: The entity number of `entity` (a pawn or any node), or `NONE`. Untyped, so a freed object can be passed.
- `from_path(node: Node) -> int` *(static)*: A hash of the node's path in the scene tree (its name if it isn't in one), from 0 to 2^31 - 1. The same scene gives the same paths on every machine; two nodes never share a path, as they can share a name.
